description: UK: Inheritance Tax on an estate including unused pensions, for deaths on or after 6 April 2027 (Finance Act 2026, Royal Assent 18 March 2026). Pensions (pots and lump sum death benefits; death in service from current employment and dependants' scheme pensions excluded) are added to the estate; 40% above the £325,000 nil rate band and the £175,000 residence nil rate band for a home left to direct descendants (tapered £1 per £2 over £2 million, pensions included in that test), with any transferred bands; spouse/civil partner and charity exempt. The tax is shared between pension and estate in proportion to value. Also gives the income tax the beneficiary pays if the member died at 75 or over (on the pension less the IHT paid on it). Use this when someone asks what Inheritance Tax their family would pay on a pension from April 2027.

beneficiaryRate.description: Beneficiary's marginal income tax rate as a decimal, e.g. 0.4 (default 0.4)

estate.description: Everything else in the estate (home, savings, investments) less debts, GBP

homeToDescendants.description: Value of the home (or share) left to children or grandchildren, GBP (default 0)

pensions.description: Unused pension pots plus lump sum death benefits, excluding death in service from current work, GBP

toSpouse.description: Amount left to a spouse or civil partner (exempt), GBP (default 0)

transferred.description: Share of a late spouse's unused bands transferred, 0 to 1 (default 0)
